Text: In the praxis repository, list every record that provides supporting OR contradicting evidence for HY-FE-2026-B006. Include evidence declared in either direction (in HY-FE-2026-B006's own metadata or in the evidence record's metadata). Answer with record ids.

In the praxis repository, record DF-ROS-2026-A047 is about to change. List every record that must be reviewed as a consequence, transitively: records that depend on or are derived from a changed record, and records whose claims a changed evidence record supports or contradicts. Use only typed metadata relations (depends_on, derived_from, supports, contradicts, supporting_evidence, contradicting_evidence), not related_documents or prose mentions. Answer with record ids.
